policies.summary: DVR & Dr. HS MIC College of Technology operates an extensive fleet of over 45 college buses covering Vijayawada, Guntur, Nandigama, Jaggaiahpeta, and surrounding towns.
policies.details: The institution provides safe, GPS-enabled transportation across more than 45 routes. Major coverage areas include: 1. Vijayawada City (Benz Circle, PNBS, Ramavarappadu Ring, Bhavanipuram, Gollapudi, Vidyadharapuram), 2. Guntur City & Environs, 3. Nandigama, 4. Jaggaiahpeta, 5. Vissannapeta, 6. Mylavaram, 7. Kodad, 8. Tiruvuru, 9. Ibrahimpatnam, and intermediate boarding points along NH-65. Buses arrive at campus by 8:45 AM and depart at 4:30 PM.
policies.actionable: Obtain an official route schedule and stop chart from the Transport In-Charge Counter.

policies.topic: Bus Pass Issuance and Transport Fee
policies.summary: Annual college bus passes are issued by the Transport Section after payment of route-wise transportation charges.
policies.details: Students must carry their authorized Bus Pass with RFID barcode daily. Bus fees vary by distance/zone and can be paid in two installments. Spot verification is conducted regularly by the vigilance transport squad.
policies.actionable: Apply for bus pass renewal at the Transport Office at the beginning of the odd semester.
